A '''distortion unit''' was fabricated from a small [[Power cell/Legends|power pack]] and circuit box. The unit scrambled the visible [[Spectrum/Legends|spectrum]] in the form of dancing light and waves of [[Color/Legends|color]], while throwing off sparks and flares in harmless light-effects.
